evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/l/M extends R55 DrawingArea and owns a second static raster state: pixel array plus clip bounds/row offsets and initialization/reset helpers.
The class implements clipped horizontal/vertical lines, rectangle outlines/fills, alpha variants, arbitrary lines and gradient-style primitive drawing directly against its raster state.
R55 RSFont calls rs/l/M.h(int,int,int,int) from live rich-text rendering for underline/strikethrough rules, proving the class is the auxiliary drawing layer used by the newer font renderer.

Public 474-era RSPS clients contain a separate DrawingArea474 class beside DrawingArea and RSFont, with the same role as the newer-font 2D primitive raster helper; exact-v308 behavior is primary authority.

proposals.note: DrawingArea474 preserves the established historical identity of the auxiliary 474-era 2D raster layer used by RSFont. Exact-v308 behavior and live consumers are primary authority.
